title: A Main Title headline keeps its second line after a font pair and energy change
goal: On a Main Title over a 1280 by 800 recording, setting the theme to Sunset, the font pair to Editorial and the energy to Punchy leaves the headline showing only "The Long Way". The word "Home" on its second line is gone from the picture. Find out why and make every line of the headline show.
notes: Seen in Scripts/playtest/hand-work-survives-new-numbers-and-a-restyle-walk.json (Scripts/playtest.sh <it> --no-build), picture 6-title-restyled-sc.png, copied to queue/audits/2026-11-22-hand-work-6-title-restyled-sc.png. Playhead at 0:01. The headline is a word reveal (riseAndFade by word, start 105 ms, stagger 63, length 630 at Punchy), so every word should be in by 1 s. Picture 5 (Original theme, before the restyle) shows two lines, The Long Way / Home. In a 1920x1080 core probe the restyled Title frame is 1536x209 (two lines) and the model is identical with and without commit for task a-chart-or-title-keeps-what-you-set-by-hand-when, so this was there before it. Not yet checked: whether the 1280x800 layout re-measures the frame for Editorial, or whether the second line is drawn under the subtitle.
acceptance: Reproduced first in the probe: the walk below, or the same steps by hand, show the headline missing its second line
After Sunset, Editorial and Punchy, the headline shows every line of its words
A walk at Next defaults photographs the whole headline after those changes

log.note: Raised to p1 at the user's word, 2026-11-26: "text would be clipped in weird spots" in a reel they made. Second repro, through the MCP tools: add_title style Kinetic Bold, text "Every window. One glance." on a 1920x1080 video: 184 pt Avenir Next Condensed bold in a 1536 x 258 box, and only "Every window. One" is ever drawn (queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/kinetic-bold-drops-glance.png). Also during its entrance at 7.2 s the bottoms of the letters are cut off by the reveal (cube-7s-and-kinetic-bold-entrance.png). Fix both here: every line of every title style shows at any length of words (shrink to fit or wrap within the frame, as the style says), and no entrance clips a letter. Check all 19 title page styles and 3 name cards with a one word, a five word and a ten word line; a test that fails on today's code.

On 0.25.0 (Dev, 2026-11-26) the Kinetic Bold repro is now Condensed Poster: 'Every window. One glance.' runs off the right edge of the 1920x1080 frame ('Every window. O' then cut), queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/on-0.25-dev/dev-title-9s.png; its entrance still cuts letter bottoms at 7.2 s (dev-cube-7s.png). Same fix: every line of every style fits inside the frame at any length of words.

Reproduced in the probe: walk picture 6 showed only 'The Long Way'. Cause: a restyle and a retype both re-measured each line of words as if on one line (TitleRestyler.measured), so a wrapped line fell outside its box; a hugging box grew past the right edge. Fix (TitleRestyle.swift): each line wraps in its own room (centred: its box inside the 5% safe edges; set from an edge: to the safe edge), the box is as tall as all lines, pieces under it move down by what it grew (the recipe now remembers each line's laid height, laidHeights, since a typed box has already grown before relayout), groups that grew push pieces under them, backing boxes behind the words grow with them, and the headline shrinks 10% a step only when the title would leave the frame. Mask reveal (TextRevealRasterizer.mask) now spans the letters' own ink, so tight-leading words are not sliced while they land. Tests: TitleEveryLineShowsTests (22 styles x 1/5/10 words x 2 frames, before and after Sunset/Editorial/Punchy; failed in 15 styles before), MaskRevealTightLeadingTests nearlyLanded (91% at 0.62 leading before). Chose wrap-then-shrink over shrink-only because a page headline over two lines is what a designer would set; shrink only when it leaves the frame. Left rough (not filed, under the bar): shrunk headline does not grow back for shorter words; a centred page grows downward not around its centre.

Every line of a title headline shows after Sunset/Editorial/Punchy and after longer words: lines wrap in their room inside the safe edges, boxes hold every line, pieces under move down, headline shrinks only when the title would leave the frame; mask reveal no longer slices tight-leading letters. Commit b95817512. Verified: TitleEveryLineShowsTests (22 styles x 1/5/10 words x 2 frames, failed in 15 before), MaskRevealTightLeadingTests, full Scripts/test.sh green, walk hand-work-survives-new-numbers-and-a-restyle-walk at Next defaults now photographs The Long Way / Home (audit 2026-11-26-title-headline-every-line.json), 6 more title walks ok.
